seo.title: Appointment Booking Software & WhatsApp Booking | FastAppoint
seo.description: FastAppoint is appointment booking software that lets clients book online or by WhatsApp. Manage staff calendars, availability, and confirmations without double-bookings.
seo.keywords: appointment booking software, online booking system, booking calendar, scheduling app, WhatsApp booking, salon booking software, clinic appointment scheduling

hero.title: Bookings your clients can make in an app -- or just by texting you.
hero.lead: Set up your services and staff in minutes, then let clients book the way they already message you: a normal WhatsApp chat, answered instantly by AI that reads your real calendar before it replies. No app to download, no double-bookings, no back-and-forth.
hero.note: No credit card. Set up your first booking in under 5 minutes.

welcome.title: Welcome to FastAppoint! 👋
welcome.description: Let's take a quick tour of your dashboard. We'll walk you through every section so you can get up and running fast.

header.title: Your Control Center
header.description: This header gives you quick access to language settings, business switching (if you manage multiple businesses), and logout.

business.title: Your Business
business.description: Set up or update your business name here. This is the first step — once saved, the Services and Resources sections become available.

nav.title: Quick Navigation
nav.description: Use these icons to switch between Services, Resources, and Calendar. Each section manages a different part of your business.

servicesIntro.title: Services ✂️
servicesIntro.description: Services are the things you offer — e.g. "Haircut 30 min" or "Room booking 1 h". Each service has a name, duration, and optional resource requirements.

servicesList.title: Service List & Editor
servicesList.description: Add a new service with the + button, or click an existing one to edit its name, duration and which resource types it needs. Use the filter icon to narrow down long lists.

serviceRequirements.title: Advanced service requirements
serviceRequirements.description: Configure fulfillment mode (quantity or capacity), required capacity, booking input key, and attribute rules here. These settings enable more precise allocation and larger-group scenarios.

resourcesIntro.title: Resources 🗄️
resourcesIntro.description: Resources are the physical assets or staff members that carry out your services — e.g. a barber chair, a treatment room, or a specific employee.

resourceTypes.title: Resource Types
resourceTypes.description: First create a type (e.g. "Barber" or "Room"), then add individual resources within it. Services link to types — not to specific resources — so FastAppoint can find the best available slot automatically.

resourceAttributes.title: Custom type attributes
resourceAttributes.description: Define typed attributes (text, number, yes/no, single-select) for each resource type. Services can then use them as filtering rules during allocation.

resourceCombining.title: Capacity-based resource combining
resourceCombining.description: Enable combining on a resource and set a shared group for compatible resources. In capacity requirements, the engine can combine resources from the same group to satisfy demand.

calendarIntro.title: Calendar 📅
calendarIntro.description: This is where all your appointments live. Switch between Day, Week, Month, and Year views using the tabs at the top.

calendarSidebar.title: Mini Calendar & Search
calendarSidebar.description: Jump to any date, adjust the visible hour range, and search for a booking by client name or phone — all from this sidebar.

calendarGrid.title: Appointment Grid
calendarGrid.description: Drag a slot on the grid to create a new booking for that exact time, or use the New Booking button to let FastAppoint pick the first available slot. Click any existing booking to view or manage it.
